document.about: USGS Techniques and Methods 5-B13 (doi:10.3133/tm5B13), on PFAS in water by direct injection. Its appendix plots measured against expected concentrations and standard deviations as scatters of small square markers, four panels to a page, each page's legend (`EXPLANATION`, `+30 percent`, `1:1 line`, `Method detection level`, `Measured concentration`, `Standard deviation`) set under the panels.

notes: #241: legend entries and axis labels of the appendix's scatter plots read as the page's text, some as bold headings.

checks.issue: #241: the legend entry `Measured concentration`, bold, read as a heading: the scatter's markers lined up in rows and columns as a table's shading does, and no figure was found. Open on p67 (0-based), the appendix's first page: its four plots with the legend under them take more than 55% of the page each way, so the region's size bound refuses the legend's last line.
#241: the legend entry `Measured concentration` was the page's text, as a heading or a paragraph, on every page of plots.
#241: the legend entry `Standard deviation` read as a heading.
#241: the legend entry `Method detection level` read as a heading.
#241: the legend's entries `+30 percent`, `1:1 line` and `−30 percent` ran together as one paragraph of the page's.
A guard: the figure's caption under its legend stays the page's paragraph.

element.text: Figure 1.16. Graphs comparing the measured concentration to amount spiked for perfluoroheptane sulfonate (PFHpS) in A, reagent water; B, groundwater; C, surface water; and D, wastewater effluent. (ng/L, nanograms per liter)
